name: Prose
gloss: Markdown or plain text, with no rows a builder or page reads.

name: Records
gloss: Rows in CSV or JSON that a builder or page reads.

name: Records with a check
gloss: Records a committed check holds the display or its payload to.

name: Records with a gold set
gloss: Checked records also scored against an independently labeled sample.

name: File
gloss: Read as a file on GitHub or in a checkout; no page renders it.

name: Page
gloss: A standalone HTML page, including a frozen study page.

name: Appendix
gloss: Framed inside an app that does not own the page.

name: App view
gloss: Rendered in an app's own document: a main view, a tab, or a Map subview.
